annotations.title: Redesign a room from a photo

description: AI interior design: redesign, redecorate or remodel a room from a photo of it, in a chosen style (for example a Japandi living room, a modern farmhouse kitchen or a cozy bedroom makeover). Keeps the room's layout and returns a photorealistic image of the new design. Uses one House AI design credit. Needs a photo: attached in chat, a public link, or an upload_id from get_photo_upload_link.

color_palette.description: Optional palette, for example 'warm tones', 'earth tones', 'monochrome'.
color_palette.title: Color Palette

notes.description: Anything specific the user asked for, in their words (for example 'keep the fireplace').
notes.title: Notes

photo.description: The room or house photo the user attached in chat. Filled in by the app, not typed.

photo_upload_id.description: The upload_id from get_photo_upload_link, once the user says the photo is uploaded.
photo_upload_id.title: Photo Upload Id

photo_url.description: A public https link to the photo, if the user gave one instead of attaching it.
photo_url.title: Photo Url

renovation.description: True for a bigger remodel that can change finishes and fixtures; false keeps the room's structure.
renovation.title: Renovation

room_type.description: The room, for example 'living room', 'kitchen', 'bedroom', 'bathroom', 'home office'.
room_type.title: Room Type

style.description: Design style, for example 'Japandi', 'Scandinavian', 'coastal'. See search_design_styles.
style.title: Style
